{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_id_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicates = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1]

duplicate_count = len(duplicates)
print(f'Duplicate patient_ids: {duplicate_count}')

# Check sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_count = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f'Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {sentinel_count}')

# Check for re-testing (multiple sample_seq per patient)
print(f'Number of patients with multiple sample_seq: {len(duplicates)}')"}
